verdict.rationale:
Klaviyo's core product includes event-triggered Flows that run autonomously (e.g., gift notifications sent automatically per docs-17) and the AI-powered Customer Agent that autonomously finds orders, checks status, and sends updates without human intervention (docs-26), plus Composer for building automated campaigns (docs-25). Pricing docs confirm 'build automations' is available even on free tier (docs-11, docs-19).

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of autonomous flow reliability, and more detail on monitoring/error-handling for long-running background automations.
